why: The preimages extrinsic at work: the block body carries 5 blobs answering earlier solicitations. Each lands under its preimage key C(s, E4(2^32-2) ++ h) and stamps its request entry with this slot. The block author's validator stats count all 5 (612 octets).
family_explainer: The preimages family exercises JAM's data-availability contract for service code and data. The service SOLICITS hashes it wants (host call 23), the chain later receives matching blobs in the block body (the E_P extrinsic), lookups serve them back (host call 2), and FORGET (24) begins the two-step expunge dance governed by the D=32-slot turnaround period.
events: Core 0: package 23a49e8f… guaranteed (3 work item(s), bundle 2757 bytes). It now waits on this core for availability assurances.
Core 1: package d64e2975… guaranteed (4 work item(s), bundle 2236 bytes). It now waits on this core for availability assurances.
6 validator assurance(s): core 0 has 6, core 1 has 5 vote(s). A report becomes AVAILABLE when votes exceed 2/3 of 6 validators (i.e. ≥ 5).

ACCUMULATION: package(s) 1b94a272…, 429cc8ed… became available and were accumulated — the service's accumulate entry point ran inside the PVM. The accumulated-set ring C(15) records them (sorted, ring 11), aging out after 12 blocks.
Service 0 statistics: 6 work item(s) accumulated for 67,031 gas (exact PVM metering — every instruction costs 1, host calls cost 10, log costs 10).
Service 0: 5 preimage(s) totalling 612 bytes provided via the block body.
E_P extrinsic: 5 preimage blob(s) (74, 42, 177, 164, 155 bytes) answer earlier solicitations: each is stored under its hash and its request entry is stamped with slot 8.
